newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX natgas still off sharply on weather.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX natgas still off sharply on weather.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures remained sharply lower late Monday in moderate activity, still pressured by forecasts for much milder Midwest and East Coast weather this week though another cold front was expected later.
At 1340 EST, February was still down by 19.7 cents at $3.06 per million British thermal units, while March was 9.4 cents lower at $2.765. Others were down by one to 3.1 cents.
"We're getting a lot of pressure from the (mild) weather, but there is more (Arctic) weather coming by the weekend, and it may be a little early to say winter is over," said one Texas-based trader.
